notes: Overrides are consumed by balance simulation/audit only until the authoritative naruto-api source is versioned and v2 parity is proven.
Legacy roster fields remain unchanged for public online compatibility.
Only high-confidence mechanics representable by Combat Rules v2 are overridden. Unsupported canonical sub-effects are recorded in limitations rather than approximated as unrelated damage/stun.

naruto-uzumaki:3.reason: Canonical skill is self damage reduction, not destructible defense.

sasuke-uchiha:3.reason: Canonical skill grants Sasuke 15 reduction and exposes one enemy for 4 turns.

hinata-hyuga:3.reason: Canonical skill is self damage reduction, not destructible defense.

fukasaku-and-shima-(s):1.reason: Canonical skill deals 20 affliction over 2 turns and increases target skill costs by one arbitrary chakra; it is not generic direct damage.

fukasaku-and-shima-(s):2.reason: Canonical skill protects all allies from Ranged skills for one turn, not only the user from every class.

fukasaku-and-shima-(s):3.reason: Canonical stun occurs only on the third consecutive use and causes no direct damage.
limitations: Combat Rules v2 cannot selectively cancel only previous stuns created by this same skill; that canonical cleanup remains pending.

white-snake-orochimaru-(s):1.reason: Canonical skill steals 35 health from an enemy and heals Orochimaru by the damage dealt.
limitations: Transformation into Kusanagi after body acquisition is not modeled by this override.

white-snake-orochimaru-(s):4.reason: Canonical skill deals 20 damage to all enemies for 3 turns and grants stun/disable immunity while active; it is not a 3-turn AoE stun.
limitations: Retaliating specifically against an enemy that stuns Orochimaru requires an on-status-applied trigger that Combat Rules v2 does not yet expose.

oboro:1.reason: Canonical skill deals exactly 15 damage to all enemies. Its base cost is two arbitrary chakra.
limitations: Canonical cost falls to one arbitrary chakra during Fog Clone; conditional cost changes are not represented in this override.

oboro:2.reason: Canonical base form targets one enemy for 20 damage and stuns only Physical and Mental skills for one turn; it is not unconditional AoE control.
limitations: During Fog Clone this skill canonically targets all enemies and costs one Genjutsu chakra; that conditional transformation remains pending.

oboro:3.reason: Canonical skill grants 30 destructible defense plus selective invulnerability to Mental, Physical and Summon skills for 3 turns.

tsume-inuzuka:1.reason: Canonical skill gives Tsume 10 flat reduction for 4 turns and enables Fierce Bite while active.
limitations: Kuromaru's 10-damage retaliation against enemies using non-Bane skills on Tsume requires a class-filtered OnHarmed trigger not yet modeled here.

tsume-inuzuka:2.reason: Canonical Fierce Bite is a 25-damage attack available during Call Kuromaru, not a multi-turn stun.
limitations: The canonical OnDeath reward (2 turns of +10 damage, Endure and Focus) requires an OnDeath trigger and is not approximated.
